s4hana.title: SAP S/4HANA
s4hana.subtitle: ERP for Large Enterprises
s4hana.description: SAP's intelligent ERP for large organizations: integrated end-to-end processes, real-time on HANA, and digital transformation at scale.
s4hana.longDescription: SAP S/4HANA is the next-generation ERP designed for large enterprises that need to operate with full visibility, speed, and adaptability. Built on the SAP HANA in-memory database, it eliminates aggregation layers and enables real-time decisions across the entire value chain: finance, supply chain, manufacturing, procurement, and sales.
